name: Virtues
overview: Scripture calls believers to embody virtues that reflect their new identity in Christ, urging them to embrace qualities such as truthfulness, patience, mercy, kindness, humility, and purity. These virtues are not merely moral ideals but are rooted in the gospel reality of God's love demonstrated through Christ's sacrifice and the transformative work of the Holy Spirit. Believers are encouraged to focus their minds on what is true, honorable, just, pure, lovely, and commendable, allowing these virtues to shape their character and relationships within the body of Christ.
